question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Eventually
solution:
The correct answer is '**Ultimately**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Eventually**' is '**Ultimately**'.
 
• **Eventually**: in the end; finally. (अंत में; अंततोगत्‍वा)
 
 
• Example: He eventually managed to persuade his parents to let him buy a motorbike.
 
 
 
• **Ultimately**: in the end. (अंततोगत्‍वा, आख़िरकार)
 
 
• *Example: **Ultimately**, the decision is yours.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** Ultimately.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Primarily**: more than anything else; mainly. (मुख्‍य रूप से)
 
• **Originally**: in the beginning, before any changes or developments. (शुरु में, किसी भी परिवर्तन और विकास के पहले, मूल रूप से)
 
• **Initially**: at the beginning; at first. (शुरू या आरंभ में; पहले)
